_README: Curated by hand from Council Directive 2006/112/EC. NEVER scraped: the Commission's own
'Territorial status of EU countries and certain territories' summary page, read
programmatically, reports the Canary Islands, Mount Athos, the Aland Islands and the French
overseas departments as INSIDE the EU VAT area. Article 6 of the Directive says the opposite.
Two fields carry different levels of confidence, deliberately:
legal_basis   - verified against the consolidated Directive text. High confidence.
postal_source - the national rule. NOT verified against a primary source yet; every entry
has verified_on: null until someone checks it. See VERIFICATION.md.
rate_unverified: true means the territory is inside the VAT area but at rates this package
has not confirmed. Resolution THROWS for those rather than returning the mainland rate,
because a wrong rate is worse than a refusal.

mount_athos.name: Mount Athos
mount_athos.postal_source: Hellenic Post; Autonomous Monastic State of the Holy Mountain

canary_islands.name: Canary Islands
canary_islands.note: Subject to IGIC, a local indirect tax, not EU VAT. TEDB reports it as an ES STANDARD row commented 'VAT - Canary Islands - '.
canary_islands.postal_source: Correos: Las Palmas 35xxx, Santa Cruz de Tenerife 38xxx

lake_lugano_italian_waters.name: Italian waters of Lake Lugano
lake_lugano_italian_waters.note: No postal code: it is a body of water, not an addressable territory. Recorded for completeness; unreachable by postcode resolution.

livigno.name: Livigno
livigno.postal_source: Poste Italiane CAP 23041 (23030 before the 2017 renumbering)

jungholz_mittelberg.name: Jungholz and Mittelberg
jungholz_mittelberg.legal_basis: UStG 1994 §10(4). Corroborated independently by TEDB, which reports an AT REDUCED 19.0 row commented 'Jungholz, Mittelberg'.

madeira.name: Madeira
madeira.legal_basis: Inside the VAT area (not listed in Directive Art. 6), at autonomous-region rates set under Portuguese law.
madeira.note: Madeira applies its own rates, lower than mainland Portugal. This package has NOT verified the current values against a Portuguese primary source, so resolution throws rather than returning the mainland rate.

azores.name: Azores
azores.legal_basis: Inside the VAT area (not listed in Directive Art. 6), at autonomous-region rates set under Portuguese law.
azores.note: As Madeira: own rates, not verified here, so resolution throws rather than guessing.

monaco.name: Monaco
monaco.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 7(1) — 'shall not be regarded ... as third countries'; Art. 7(2) requires transactions to be treated as French.

isle_of_man.name: Isle of Man
isle_of_man.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 7(1)-(2) — treated as the United Kingdom.
isle_of_man.note: GB is not in the TEDB snapshot, so this entry documents the treatment without being resolvable to a rate. Recorded so a caller is told why, rather than getting silence.
